Glass Marble Balls

A fun casual mobile game with social and cloud features, launching soon on Android.

  • Start with 50 balls, plus a 50 ball signup bonus
  • Daily Bonus rewards, every single day
  • Achievements to unlock as you play
  • Global Leaderboard to compete with other players
  • Sign in with Google for a fast and secure login
  • Cloud save keeps your progress safe on any device
  • Watch ads for extra rewards and bonus balls
  • Custom themes to personalize your game

M3 Player

Your all-in-one local music player for Android. Version 1.0.

  • Play every song already on your device
  • Browse by Albums, Singers, or Folders
  • Create and manage your own Playlists
  • Favorites — save the songs you love
  • Search any song, artist or album instantly
  • MP3 Cutter — trim songs without losing quality
  • Equalizer with genre presets, virtualizer and reverb
  • Lyrics viewer for the song you're playing
  • Sleep Timer — music stops automatically
  • Automatic Cover Art for your albums
